site.math.tagline.englishSource: Today's quest: one round of math!

site.english.tagline.englishSource: Today's quest: one round of English!

site.math.description.englishSource: Game-style math for elementary, middle and high school students. Short 3-10 minute quests take you from concepts to problem solving, with hints so you can work it out yourself.

site.english.description.englishSource: Game-style English for elementary, middle and high school students. Learn words, grammar and sentence building in short quests.

landing.eyebrow.englishSource: Don't come to study, come for a quest

landing.how1.body.englishSource: 3-10 minutes at a time. Concept, example, practice, challenge: build easy wins step by step.

landing.how2.body.englishSource: It's fine to get it wrong. A small hint, a concrete hint, then the steps, until you understand.

landing.how3.body.englishSource: XP, levels, streaks and the skill map show how much you grew today.

landing.privacy.englishSource: We don't ask for your real name, phone number or school. A nickname and your grade are enough.
